text: Ten lessons of work only holds up if someone can measure whether it's actually working. This lesson builds the KPIs and the workflow behind them.

Five KPIs, deliberately few: CDE ownership coverage, quality check pass rate, average issue resolution time, access recertification completion, and access request response time — a direct, measured answer to the Lesson 1 incident.

Every issue moves through the same four stages: detect, when a steward notices a failure or a request arrives. Triage, classified by the Lesson 3 CDE criteria. Resolve, within the steward's authority or escalated per the Lesson 4 RACI. Review, rolled into the monthly report Dana Whitfield takes to the board.
Four stages, five KPIs, on purpose. A workflow a steward can recite from memory gets followed; an elaborate ticketing taxonomy nobody can explain in one sentence doesn't.
Next: Lesson 12 chooses the governance operating model that houses all of this — the structure, not just the metrics.
